hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB (WSL2, driver from Windows)
hardware.note: Linux side: a WSL2 Ubuntu 22.04 distribution. GPU shared with the Windows desktop compositor; every timing block waited for the idle criterion recorded in gpu_idle.

slab.name: slab
slab.description: Lossless dielectric slab at normal incidence in a periodic 2D cell (TMz: Ez, Hx, Hy). Solvers without a 2D mode use a 3D grid with one periodic cell along z.

slab.note: Ez nodes at x=-4+k*0.025 um; the slab covers the eight Ez nodes x=-0.075..0.100 um (indices 157..164), i.e. exactly 0.2 um of staircased material.

source.note: Additive (soft) Ez sheet over the whole periodic y span at one x node, applied after the E update of every step with the sample at t=(n+1)*dt.

spectrum.note: 31 samples equally spaced in frequency between c/1.8um and c/1.3um.

sphere.name: sphere
sphere.description: Dielectric sphere scattering cross-section from a closed TFSF box (TorchFDTD, FDTDX) or a Meep native plane-wave-plus-flux-box setup.

reference.note: Bohren-Huffman a_n/b_n with SciPy spherical Bessel functions, as in examples/tfsf_sphere.py.

fdtdx_plane_source.kind: UniformPlaneSource one-way plane (no closed TFSF box in fdtdx 0.6.2)
fdtdx_plane_source.note: Spans the full y,z domain including the PML; the flux box faces lie in the total-field region, so the empty-domain phasors are subtracted before the scattered flux is integrated.

meep_plane_source.kind: planewave current sheet spanning the full cell (Meep Mie tutorial setup, no TFSF box)
meep_plane_source.note: Ez current sheet at the PML interface spanning the full cell including the PML; scattered flux = total-run flux minus empty-run DFT fields (load_minus_flux_data).

throughput.name: throughput
throughput.description: Forward throughput on the benchmarks/open_source.py vacuum and sphere scenes: 4.8 um cube, 800 steps, point Ez source and point Ez monitor.
throughput.index_note: Ez Yee node indices (x,y integer nodes, z half node) as resolved by torchfdtd.solver.index_at for yee sampling; z=0 lies exactly between two half nodes and the resolved index is recorded here so that every solver uses the same cell.

adjoint.name: adjoint
adjoint.description: Full scalar-per-cell epsilon gradient of a two-probe loss in a periodic dielectric box (docs/FDTDX_MATCHED_FULL_GRADIENT.md fixture at 128 steps).
adjoint.boundaries: all six periodic, zero Bloch phase

source.note: Additive Ex kick at one vacuum cell after the E update; kick[n]=waveform((n+1)*dt). FDTDX injects -C*inv_eps*profile[n] at time n*dt, so profile=-kick/C at the fixed inv_eps=1 source cell.

adjoint.design_variables: all 64^3 cells except the source cell (gradient reported on the full array; source-cell entry is zero by construction in TorchFDTD and in FDTDX)
adjoint.meep: Meep is excluded: its adjoint is a frequency-domain method with different semantics.

torchfdtd.method: Soft Ez sheet, air reference run, plane monitors with trilinear Yee interpolation and half-step H phase, T=flux/flux_air, R=-(flux of sample-minus-air fields)/flux_air.

pml.formulation: stretched-coordinate CPML, cubic sigma profile sigma=40*rho^3/(L+1) in Courant units, kappa=1, alpha=1e-8

fdtdx.method: 3D grid (320,20,1) with periodic y and z, soft Ez sheet through PointDipoleSource over the sheet slice with a sampled profile (-kick/C), PhasorDetector planes with exact_interpolation (E/H co-located at the Ez node, H time-centred by (H_prev+H)/2), pulse scaling; T=flux/flux_air, R=-(flux of sample-minus-air phasors)/flux_air.

pml.formulation: FDTDX CPML, cubic sigma with sigma_end matched to TorchFDTD maximum 40/(L+1) Courant units, kappa=1, alpha matched to 1e-8 Courant units; FDTDX grades on d/L with E and H half-cell offsets

meep.method: 2D TMz cell (Ez, Hx, Hy), y periodic through k_point=0, PML of the same thickness on x (Meep stretched-coordinate PML, quadratic default profile), Ez CustomSource current sheet with the shared waveform, eps_averaging=False, DFT flux monitors; air reference run, load_minus_flux_data on the reflection monitor: T=flux/flux_air, R=-flux_scattered/flux_air.

pml.formulation: Meep PML (stretched-coordinate, quadratic profile by default, R_asymptotic=1e-15), same thickness 0.4 um

torchfdtd.method: Closed TFSF box (live 1D Yee incident line, 96 auxiliary CPML cells), six scattered-field plane monitors at +-1.1 um, matched empty-box reference subtracted field-wise, incident intensity from the empty-box centre plane.

pml.formulation: stretched-coordinate CPML, cubic sigma profile, kappa=1, alpha=1e-8

fdtdx.method: No closed TFSF box in fdtdx 0.6.2: native one-way UniformPlaneSource (single-plane TFSF) spanning the full transverse domain including the PML, at the first interior x cell; total field downstream. Six PhasorDetector planes at +-1.1 um with exact_interpolation, empty-domain reference subtracted phasor-wise (removes the incident field), incident intensity from the empty-domain centre plane; shared per-component staircase permittivity array.

pml.formulation: FDTDX CPML, cubic sigma with sigma_end matched to TorchFDTD maximum, kappa=1, alpha matched

meep.method: No TFSF box: Meep Mie-tutorial setup. Ez current sheet spanning the full cell (including the PML, hence is_integrated=True) at x=-1.2 um with the shared waveform as the integrated current, six DFT flux planes at +-1.1 um, empty-cell run subtracted with load_minus_flux_data, incident intensity from the empty-cell centre plane (0.4 x 0.4 um). Sphere geometry rasterised by Meep at each Yee component position with eps_averaging=False.

pml.formulation: Meep PML (stretched-coordinate, quadratic profile by default, R_asymptotic=1e-15), same thickness 0.4 um

methods.torchfdtd: benchmarks.open_source.scene projects, fused CUDA kernels, CUDA graph capture, float32. Full solve = Simulation(project).run() wall time including voxelization, grid and graph construction and the final host copy of E, H and the point trace. Stepping = summary["seconds"] (captured loop only). One warm-up solve per case, then the listed repetitions.
methods.fdtdx: run_fdtd inside jax.jit (donated arrays), float32, GPU. Full solve = place_objects + apply_params + shared permittivity upload + jitted run + host copy of E, H and the probe trace, after one warm-up that includes XLA compilation (recorded separately). Stepping = jitted call alone with block_until_ready.
methods.meep: mp.Simulation with the shared point Ez CustomSource, sphere geometry rasterised by Meep (eps_averaging=False), same PML thickness (Meep PML formulation), all MPI ranks on the CPU. Full solve = init_sim + run(until=steps*dt) with a per-step get_field_point probe + get_array of all six field components. Stepping = run() alone. One warm-up solve per case, then the listed repetitions. Wall time measured on the master rank after MPI barriers.

torchfdtd_checkpointed.method: DifferentiableSimulation, discrete adjoint of the fused CUDA Yee step, device checkpoints (binomial replay), loss.backward() on the full scalar-per-cell epsilon tensor. Time to gradient = wall time of tensor upload, forward, backward and synchronize after one warm-up call.

fdtdx_checkpointed.method: jax.value_and_grad of the two-probe loss with respect to the scalar-per-cell epsilon array (inv_permittivities=1/eps), run_fdtd with GradientConfig(method='checkpointed'); the whole forward+backward is one jitted executable compiled once (compile time recorded separately). Time to gradient = host upload of epsilon + executable + block_until_ready.

fdtdx_reversible.method: jax.value_and_grad of the two-probe loss with respect to the scalar-per-cell epsilon array (inv_permittivities=1/eps), run_fdtd with GradientConfig(method='reversible'); the whole forward+backward is one jitted executable compiled once (compile time recorded separately). Time to gradient = host upload of epsilon + executable + block_until_ready.

fdtdx_checkpointed16.method: jax.value_and_grad of the two-probe loss with respect to the scalar-per-cell epsilon array (inv_permittivities=1/eps), run_fdtd with GradientConfig(method='checkpointed'); the whole forward+backward is one jitted executable compiled once (compile time recorded separately). Time to gradient = host upload of epsilon + executable + block_until_ready.

adjoint.meep: excluded: Meep implements a frequency-domain adjoint with different semantics

methods.torchfdtd: benchmarks.open_source.scene projects, fused CUDA kernels, CUDA graph capture, float32. Full solve = Simulation(project).run() wall time including voxelization, grid and graph construction and the final host copy of E, H and the point trace. Stepping = summary["seconds"] (captured loop only). One warm-up solve per case, then the listed repetitions.
methods.beamz: Simulation.run(backend='auto') on the PyPI release, float32, GPU. Full solve = Simulation.run (plan, runtime setup, stepping, result decoding) + host copy of the point DFT value, after one warm-up that includes JAX compilation (recorded separately). Stepping = SimulationPerformance.runtime_s, BeamZ's own timing of the compiled executable. The timed solves use a one-frequency point FieldMonitor; the point trace comes from one additional untimed solve with a per-step FieldRecorder at the same Ez node.
